modules.name: riantr/moonbit_dowhy
modules.description: MoonBit port of DoWhy 0.14 (PyWhy). Causal graph construction and analysis, effect identification (backdoor / frontdoor / complete adjustment), estimation (linear regression, generalized linear model, propensity score weighting / matching / stratification, doubly robust, instrumental variable, two stage, regression discontinuity), refutation (bootstrap, placebo treatment, data subset, dummy outcome, unobserved common cause, the assess overlap refuter that learns the rules of the support and of the overlap with boolean rules), intervention sampling (do samplers), temporal graphs, causal discovery (the PC algorithm with the Fisher-z test) and the portable core of the graphical causal models (the p-value merging, the bootstrap confidence intervals, the Kullback-Leibler divergences, the density estimators, the Shapley values, the independence tests, the prediction models, the model that selects itself out of a zoo of models, the causal mechanisms, the automatic assignment of the causal mechanisms with the selection of the model of a node by cross validation, the fitting of a causal model, the what-if queries (the interventional samples, the counterfactual samples and the average causal effect), the validation layer (the kernel based conditional independence test, the validation of a causal structure and the validation of an invertible model) and the falsification layer (the local Markov condition, the pairwise dependencies, the parental d-separations, the causal minimality and the permutation test of a graph) and the model evaluation layer (the normalised mean squared error, the continuous ranked probability score, the performance of the causal mechanisms, the test of the invertibility assumption and the report of the evaluation) and the distribution change layer (the test of the change of a mechanism, the attribution of the change of the distribution of a target node, the multiply-robust attribution of the change of the mean or of the variance of a target node and the scores of the change of the distribution of every node). Pure MoonBit with zero external runtime dependencies.

modules.name: riantr/moonbit_image
modules.description: Pure-MoonBit image decoder/encoder covering BMP / QOI / TGA / PNG / GIF / JPEG / ICO / TIFF / FIM with zero external runtime dependencies. Decoders raise a structured `DecodeError` sub-error type so callers can branch on cause (UnsupportedFormat / TruncatedData / InvalidHeader / InvalidValue / EncodeNotImplemented). 0.3.7 re-licensed under MIT only (was `MIT OR Apache-2.0`); see LICENSE-MIT for the full text. 0.3.8 compiles against the current MoonBit core (the `try?` operator was removed upstream) and declares js / wasm-gc support in addition to native. 0.3.9 corrects the release note for 0.3.8; the code is unchanged. 0.3.10 fixes a crash in detect_format() on TGA files carrying a v2 footer and adds decode tests for the JPEG / PNG / GIF / TGA codecs. 0.3.11 adds from-scratch encoders for PNG / GIF / JPEG / TGA / ICO / TIFF (the DEFLATE, LZW and DCT code is written in this package, with no new dependency) and fixes three decoder bugs they exposed: the JPEG inverse DCT transposed every 8x8 block, the PNG inflater dropped the tail of the stream, and the ICO decoder read DIB-only entries at double height. 0.3.12 keeps the release CI's log files out of the published package; the codecs are unchanged. 0.3.13 is the result of a speed and quality comparison against the reference implementation: the TIFF decoder gains LZW / PackBits / Deflate, multiple strips and the horizontal predictor, the TIFF encoder writes compressed strips, the JPEG decoder gets the AAN inverse DCT and an eight-bit-at-a-time Huffman table (about six times faster), the GIF encoder stops writing corrupt files once the LZW table fills up, and the PNG inflater is rewritten. The quality is unchanged and no format is measurably worse than the reference. 0.3.14 hardens every decoder against malformed input: a u32 above 2^31 read into a signed Int32 became a negative offset that passed every bounds check, and the region checks and the allocation sizes themselves overflowed an Int32 on a corrupt header. The decoders now use a checked size helper, a 2^27-pixel cap and Int64 region checks, the JPEG decoder no longer trusts the contents of its segments, and the GIF colour tables and the JPEG marker loop are bounds-checked. PixelFormat and ImageFormat are pub(all), so their variants can be constructed by a consumer, and the package ships a native-only malformed-input regression test.

modules.name: riantr/moonbit_labeler
modules.description: Desktop app binaries (Windows x86-64, .zip and single-file .exe): https://github.com/riantr/moonbit-labeler/releases -- this module is the backend only. Image / video labeling backend for the MoonBit Labeler app: 27 async ops over @fs/@json for folder browsing, image IO, label IO, schema normalization (parse/serialize round-trip), class management (including the class rename), per-frame video labels, and VOC/YOLO/COCO export. The op_handlers are pure async MoonBit functions and can be wired into any IPC layer (Proton/CEF, stdio JSON-RPC, HTTP, WASM, custom bridge). Includes a `pub async fn dispatch_op(op : String, payload : Json) -> Json` entry point (in `extensions/labeler`) for embedding outside the CEF runtime; the package is native-only, so a consuming package must declare `supported_targets = \"native\"`.

modules.name: riantr/snn_mbt
modules.description: Bit-exact MoonBit port of SpikingNeuralNetworks.jl, extended with modern training machinery. NEURONS AND PLASTICITY: IF, AdEx, Izhikevich (IZ), HH, MorrisLecar, Poisson (including InhomogeneousPoisson), WilsonCowan; Markram STP, Gerstner / MexicanHat / AntiSymmetric / vSTDP / Confavreux2025 STDP; AMPA / NMDA / GABAa / GABAb receptors; multicompartment dendritic neurons (BallAndStick, Tripod, Multipod); IF with population synaptic conductance; spike-time and current stimuli. CORE DL: Tensor struct with broadcasting + softmax / log-softmax / cross-entropy, Conv2d / MaxPool2d / GlobalAvgPool2d / ReLU / Flatten / Linear forward AND backward, ResNet foundations, generic Chain / Sequential, pre-made MLP / SimpleCNN / LeLen5 bottles, image adapter (BMP/QOI/TGA/PNG/GIF/JPEG/ICO/TIFF) via riantr/moonbit_image, 5D [T,B,C,H,W] STImage. OPTIMIZERS AND SCHEDULING: SGD, SGD-with-momentum, Adam with bias correction, AdamW, RMSprop, AdaGrad, Adafactor; StepLR, ExponentialLR, CosineAnnealingLR, ReduceLROnPlateau; BatchNorm2d with running stats and LayerNorm per-sample, both with backward. SURROGATE GRADIENTS AND ATTENTION: fast-sigmoid (Zenke & Ganguli 2018) for BPTT through IF/LIF Heaviside; GELU, exact sparse GELU via libm erff; multi-head self-attention with mask utilities; sinusoidal and learnable positional encoding; Pre-Norm transformer block; inverted dropout; SAttention unifying three spiking attention variants; LayerScale; T5-style relative position bias; SpikingMultiHeadAttention with full BPTT backward; SpikeFormer demo. RL: SequenceReplayBuffer for recurrent RL, DDPG, TD3, SAC, GRU/LSTM/GTrXL recurrent actors and critics, Decision Transformer, Trajectory Transformer with beam search. META-LEARNING AND CAUSAL: MAML, FOMAML, Reptile, TaskSampler; LinearGaussianSCM, DoCalculus, CounterfactualReasoning, CausalEffectEstimator. GENERATIVE: RealNVP / Glow / NormalizingFlow, VAE, IWAE, ELBO, DDPM diffusion, EnergyBasedModel with Langevin sampling, DCGAN, WGAN-GP. OTHER: Vision Transformer with trainer, EmbeddingNet / SiameseNet / SiameseTrainer, CapsuleNetwork. GRAPH NEURAL NETWORKS: Graph with COO edge list and GCN adjacency normalisation; GCN, MPNN, GIN, PNA, GAT (multi-head), Set2Set readout, EdgeGNN, H2GCN, GraphClassifier -- and FULL BACKWARD PASSES for all of them, dispatched behind a single TrainableGraphNet enum, with node-level and graph-level training steps.
